steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for deliver a consistent bias model. knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設已知有效折射率改變 Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴、L=2 mm、λ=1550 nm，單一路徑 Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=−1.621 rad。另取集總 R=50 Ω、C=100 fF，f_RC=1/(2πRC)=31.83 GHz；這個電氣單極估計不是整體電光頻寬。 Δn_eff 是自行指定的有號模態差，未由某劑量或偏壓保證；載子濃度、重疊、吸收、電容與 RF 傳輸必須以同一截面及偏壓驗證。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical known Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴, L=2 mm and λ=1550 nm, single-path Δφ=−1.621 rad. Separately, lumped R=50 Ω and C=100 fF give f_RC=31.83 GHz; this electrical single-pole estimate is not total electro-optic bandwidth. Δn_eff is an independently chosen signed modal difference, not guaranteed by a dose or bias. Carrier distribution, overlap, absorption, capacitance and RF propagation must be validated for the same cross-section and bias.
